Translations.Text: Piedras Australes es una empresa familiar, con más de 40 años de historia, que cuenta con fábrica y tiendas de Lapislázuli en Chile, Argentina y Australia, donde nos encargamos de diseñar y entregar a nuestros clientes productos con diseños exclusivos, de gran fineza y de un valor incalculable.

Piedras Australes is a family bussines company with more than 40 years of history, with a factory and Lapislázuli stores in Chile, Argentina and Australia, where we have a mission of design and deliver to our customers products with exclusive designs, of great fineness and incalculable value. \r\nOur craftsmen are in charge to elaborating fine jewels and articles of decoration in Lapislazuli, with Silver, Gold and Copper. Also visit us at piedraaustrales.com
